Real-time creditBanking · Indonesia5 min read

Bank Rakyat Indonesia: loans paid out in two minutes with real-time credit scoring

How Indonesia’s largest bank used event-driven systems to decide on credit at the moment of the request.

Context

Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) is one of the largest banks in Indonesia, with a strong presence in microcredit and customers who depend on speed to access working capital.

The problem

A credit analysis based on batch-consolidated data takes hours or days. For someone who needs the money to run a business, that wait means giving up or going elsewhere; for the bank it means losing the deal and deciding on stale information.

The solution

According to Confluent, BRI built event-driven systems for credit scoring with Confluent Platform and Apache Kafka. Customer data arrives as events, the score is computed in the stream and the decision comes out at the moment of the request.

Results

Confluent documents loans paid out in two minutes. The bank’s Executive Vice President credits these real-time credit scoring systems with part of what made BRI the most profitable bank in Indonesia.

What this means for your team

Instant credit is a direct contest between banks and fintechs. What sets the speed is not the model but having up-to-date customer features at decision time: recent activity, in-app behavior, current exposure. Computing that in the stream instead of in the overnight batch is what makes a decision in minutes possible.
